blocks.text: Machine learning aaj ki zindagi ke bohat se shobon mein istemal hoti hai. Yeh idaron ko bohat sara data jaldi parakhne mein madad deti hai, jaise healthcare (sehat), business, education (taleem) aur rozmarra zindagi mein (Figure 6.5). Bohat se systems seekhe hue patterns se khud ba khud kaam karte hain. Is se insani mehnat kam hoti hai aur waqt bachta hai.
